title: Medical College of Wisconsin Celebrates Groundbreaking for New On-Campus Student Housing Complex
summary_en: During an official groundbreaking ceremony of the Medical College of Wisconsin’s first student housing project on July 28, Shekar Kurpad, MD, PhD, MCW president and CEO, announced the building’s name: Trailmark at MCW.
